variants.when: About 2009–2011 Milan, Mariner and Sable with a message center and SETUP and RESET buttons
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON. The engine does not need to be running.
Press SETUP until the message center shows the oil life screen, worded like OIL LIFE XXX% HOLD RESET = NEW.
Press and hold RESET for about two seconds, then let go. Oil life goes back to 100%.
variants.note: Tapping RESET while OIL LIFE SET TO XXX% is showing lowers the starting value 10% per tap. Leave it at 100% unless your shop advised otherwise.

variants.when: About 2009–2011 Grand Marquis and 2009 Mountaineer, where the screen asks HOLD RESET IF NEW OIL
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Press SETUP repeatedly until the message center reaches the oil life item.
Press RESET until the display asks HOLD RESET IF NEW OIL.
Press and hold RESET for a few seconds until the display confirms oil life is set to 100%.

variants.when: Mercury models with a tire pressure monitoring system (for example Mariner from 2006, Mountaineer and Milan in later years)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the sticker in the driver's door opening.
Drive above 20 mph for at least two minutes.
The light goes out on its own once the system reads good pressures. There is no reset button or menu for it.
If the tires are set correctly, the spare is not on the car, and the light stays on, have the system checked.
variants.note: If the light flashes for about a minute at start-up and then stays on, that is a system fault that a reset or more air will not clear. The temporary spare has no sensor, so the light stays on while it is fitted.

notes: Mercury models are twins of Ford models of the same years (Milan and Fusion, Mariner and Escape, Mountaineer and Explorer, Sable and Taurus, Grand Marquis and Crown Victoria), so the Ford steps usually apply. Many older Mercury models have no oil life item in the message center. If yours has none, change the oil by the mileage schedule in the owner guide.
